title: PerpsFun Review: Should You Trust It in 2026?
description: PerpsFun review: what its site claims about a $250 deposit, AI trading and a 4.6/5 rating, and what to check before you sign up.
author: Daniel Carter
excerpt: PerpsFun promotes AI trading with a $250 minimum and a 4.6/5 rating, but names no operator or regulator.
content:
PerpsFun is presented as an AI-assisted trading platform with automated trades, a demo account and a $250 starting point. The page leaves out the operator, the regulator and the licence number, and its one performance figure is an unsourced 4.6/5 rating.

The name points to perpetual futures, but the page does not describe perpetual contracts. Its asset table lists futures only, while the body lists crypto. We explain the page's own claims here and flag each point we were unable to check.

PerpsFun at a Glance

Here is what the platform's own page states and what it leaves out.

CategoryWhat the page says
Platform typeAI-assisted trading with automatic and manual modes
Minimum deposit$250, currency not named
FeesNone stated. No schedule given
Payment methodsCards, PayPal, Skrill and bank transfer, with other options unnamed
WithdrawalsUsually within 24 hours. No limits given
SupportDescribed as 24/7, with no channels listed
Regulator or licenceNot stated
OperatorNot named

Items come from the platform's own page. We have not tested the platform.

Is PerpsFun Legit? What the Claims Show

Automatic execution and signal claims

The page says AI and machine learning generate signals and can place trades automatically, with a manual mode for users who prefer control. Without the strategy, model or risk limits set out, the page offers no way to test what it says.

Performance and ratings

The page refers to a high success rate and notable gains from a small deposit, but gives no return figures, time period, sample size or method. Neither a source nor a review total accompanies the 4.6/5 rating.

Asset coverage

The name points to perpetual futures, but the page does not describe perpetual contracts. Its asset table lists futures only, while the body lists crypto. Ahead of registration, the page gives no clear picture of the markets that are actually open to you.

Costs and Minimum Deposit

The page states a $250 minimum deposit and says there are no registration, transaction or withdrawal fees. The page does not list a fee schedule, spreads or any charges made by payment providers.

This review uses a 250 baseline in your own currency, so that is AUD 250 in Australia, GBP 250 in the UK and EUR 250 in European Union countries. Because the currency for the $250 figure is not stated, look up the exact amount and its currency in the terms first.

Who Is Behind PerpsFun

The page names no legal entity, company number or address. Sign-up buttons go to coinpulse.cc, which is a third-party domain, and the page does not say whether the publisher takes a commission from them.

Is PerpsFun a Scam? Withdrawals and Complaints

Searches for PerpsFun often ask whether it is a scam, whether withdrawals work and whether there are complaints. Withdrawal processing in about a day is claimed, but the page includes no limits, timelines or complaint procedure.

Look for complaint records and reviews from independent bodies, with their sources named, before depositing. How withdrawal requests are handled is not shown by a rating or by positive testimonials.

Before You Register: A Short Checklist

  • Find the legal company behind PerpsFun and check it against your national regulator's register.
  • Before depositing, obtain a written list of all fees, including the spreads and withdrawal costs.
  • Seek out performance history that you can check and that carries dates, not just a single score.
  • Start small, using only what you can afford to lose, and practise on the demo first.

Risk factors to weigh before you join

The main risk is an unnamed operator, because a user has no clear party to hold to account. Where the page's claims do not match, the risk rises. A system that places trades for you does not remove the risk that those trades lose money.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is PerpsFun legit?

The site makes claims about PerpsFun but names no operator, regulator or licence number. Use the company registry and the regulator's register to check the business before you pay in.

What is the minimum deposit for PerpsFun?

The currency behind the $250 figure is not specified on the page. Confirm both the sum and the currency in the terms before paying anything.

Is PerpsFun regulated?

Without a named regulator or licence, the page refers to brokers that it does not identify. Look up the company that operates the service on the register kept by your national regulator.

Does PerpsFun charge fees?

Fees are said to be absent, though the page lists no schedule covering spreads, withdrawals or currency conversion. Read the full terms first.

Does the use of automation eliminate the chance of loss?

No. A system that places trades for you does not remove the risk that those trades lose money.

Our Verdict on PerpsFun

PerpsFun's page makes broad claims without naming an operator, a regulator or verifiable results. Our rating reflects these gaps. A further look will be taken when the operator and its claims can be verified. Risk nothing you cannot afford to write off.
